english.title: Pilot in command of aircraft not trained/did not apply procedures when ACAS II used
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the pilot in command of an aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), when ACAS II was used and
(A)_[did not apply the appropriate operational procedures and be adequately trained]_
(B)_[commenced a flight without being satisfied that every member of the flight crew was adequately trained]_
english.legislation: Contrary to Articles 80(1)(b)(i) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
were the operator or pilot in command of an aircraft, when ACAS II was used
and when the pilot in command did not apply the appropriate operational procedures and was not adequately trained OR
commenced a flight without being satisfied that every member of the flight crew was adequately trained

english.standardstatementoffacts:
